governanceExposures: Mandatory task_context included Board/research summaries, scope/architecture decisions and userExperience guidance, also injected before the task; these are unavoidable prior context, not a fully blind trial.

commit_changes required a Brain scan before committing. Scanned mandatory governance commit workflow; read only Verified delivery workflow v1 (f843b798-9b2a-4a3f-89f3-0c14463227d2). UI UX component creation patterns appeared as title/description only, not read. No artistic or previous-trial knowledge sought.

prompts.initial: Create a cinematic scene from this host's real revenue dashboard, preserving its component/provider/design and making the camera/depth/focus purposeful; leave normal app alone. Not a fake dashboard.
prompts.feedback: Feedback: retain the same subject, actual components/provider, viewpoint and camera rail. Make the reveal take twice as long and deepen the in-focus range gently (less aggressive softness), using only the installed guide/contracts. Keep final camera endpoint unchanged. Save revised.scene.json with same ID; parent tests expect duration changes and preserved component source/identity. Record this exact feedback in trial.json. Complete your scoped validation, commit and close.

initialConcept.subject: Existing revenue heading, fetched revenue and Inspect control
initialConcept.camera: 38-degree fixed Y orientation, z -200, vertical rail -50 to 70; no rotating page
initialConcept.focus: Distance 1000 with fStop 5.6, focalLength 100 and maxBlur 6; tilted page supplies near/far depth without cloning UI.
initialConcept.timing: 3000 authored milliseconds at speed 0.5 = 6000 presentation milliseconds
initialConcept.rationale: The host exports only a complete App and DashboardProvider. Preserve them as one visual leaf; do not invent dashboard fragments or copy the provider. With only rotateY, canonical matrixFor confirms the y direction remains the page tangent.

limits: Source authoring and public metadata checks only; no browser, pixel, provider request count, seek/reopen or MP4 evidence. Parent owns disposable installed-host verification and snapshot generation.
Scene framing is provisional until parent browser inspection. One tilted plane offers progressive depth, not separate floating layers.
No API credentials or app records serialized; live revenue stays in the host provider.

revision.rationale: Double authored duration and keyframe times with speed and endpoints unchanged; raise aperture fStop per installed focus guidance for a deeper, gentler in-focus range. Binding, camera, node identity and other focus settings remain identical.

publicContractGap: loadSceneRecipes declares input: unknown; discovered sources:[{path,document}] and bindingPaths through public validation diagnostics. No private implementation read.
browserExpectations: One live Existing revenue dashboard; Revenue: 12840 after host provider fetch; Inspect button state survives seeking.
Compare initial at 0/3000/6000 ms with revision at 0/6000/12000 ms: identical camera framing, gentler focus in revision.
Check tilted plane progressive focus, all intermediate frames for clipping, normal app untouched, same revised recipe after reopening; parent owns actual evidence.

passed: Morphite run_checks: all 1 checks passed (build:library + check-agent-trial)
checks.coverage: Both public catalog/authoring validations; missing binding, identity and legacy-focus rejection; exact feedback delta; matching camera positions at seven normalized times; unchanged binding hash; real component/provider AST checks and negative private-math/cloned/invented UI; TypeScript transpilation only (not installed consumer type resolution).

evidence: Actual npm tarball installed into independent host; npm exec flute init uses installed bin
Strict TypeScript consumer check and host production build
Exact guide example and agent initial/revised source render real provider revenue and one live component
Five timestamps preserve DOM and Inspect1; JSON HMR changes duration without state reset; reload reopens revised source
Real cached snapshots for both scenes; 390px no document overflow
Revised 12-second MP4 encoded at 30fps, 360 frames, FFprobe checked; export screenshot inspected without chrome
Production host bundle excludes unused studio renderer
parentIntegration.visualLimits: Inspected frames prove live host wiring, tilted camera and focus behavior; minimal test host is not a cinematic design template or universal LLM quality guarantee.

releaseAdaptation: The single package import in scene.tsx.txt was mechanically changed from @flute/scene to @webprodigies/flute for public distribution. Verification normalizes only that import before checking the original immutable binding hash. No new independent authoring trial is claimed.
